failure_modes: Temporal blend or temporal-region attention driven by sign-unstable observed-node contrasts could displace surrounding coordinates without affinity benefit, degrading secondary strain/validity.
Treating the geometric teacher-proximity contrast as an affinity reward target would misdirect the design, since it is not the score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian.
Any temperature change would be an interface violation; none is proposed.
No decoded terminal affinity labels are available, so any claimed affinity advantage of an edit would be unverifiable.
rationale: D1.2: The offered time-conditioned alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009/C010/C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change regional attention or blend a validated observed-node contrast into the teacher term; they do not change teacher coordinates and are not velocity forces. The incumbent is the static program (D2_without_trajectory_static) with no temporal recipe active. Analyst's temporal evidence is only weakly identified: continuous contrasts are observed-node linear fits with extrapolation disallowed, polynomial fits rejected, 4-10 sign changes and 1-9 strong sign conflicts at relative node RMSE 0.29-0.78 (F003), and the information audit states the geometric teacher-proximity metrics are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian and not a validated affinity predictor (F004). D4.1: The objective is final predicted affinity primary with no decoded terminal affinity labels or current-study outcomes supplied (F001, F005), so no offered edit has a defensible expected affinity advantage over the incumbent; the evidence does not shift the decision toward an edit. D4.2: The predicted failure of a temporal blend is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates driven by a sign-unstable contrast (H001 falsifier: no stable sign or batch direction fraction >= 0.857, or RMSE > 0.35 with strong sign conflicts), which would degrade strain/validity without demonstrated affinity gain; H002 confirms the excess-distance contrast is descriptive geometry only. Retaining the incumbent preserves the shared learned support and the fixed temperatures, and avoids an unsupported dose/attention change.
